part2_lower_bounds.statement: Rigorous counting bound (analytic, this script): any algorithm using N controlled-Q / Q^-1 calls (Q = Grover iterate) produces a final state sum_{j=-N..N} e^{2 i j theta}|v_j> (Mande-de Wolf Claim 5.3 degree argument), i.e. inside a (2N+1)-dim subspace; discriminating K two-point laws on [0,S] with means spaced >2e, each with success >= 1-delta, forces (1-delta)K <= 2N+1. With raw A / A^-1 access (2 queries per Q) the subspace is (2T+1)-dim in e^{i theta}, so N_equiv = T/2 >= ((1-delta)K-1)/4.
